subject: math

objective.text: Use metric measurement to model the decomposition of one whole into tenths.

explanations.title: Ten bags make 1 kilogram
explanations.text: 10 equal bags of rice weigh 1 kilogram together. Each bag is 1 tenth of the whole. Cut a tape diagram into 10 equal parts to show it.

explanations.title: Decimal form of a tenth
explanations.text: 1 tenth is written as a fraction, and also as the decimal 0.1. We say zero point one. The dot is the decimal point. All these forms are equal.

explanations.title: 10 tenths is 1
explanations.text: 10 tenths is 1 one and 0 tenths. The scale shows it as 1.0. Counting tenths goes 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, up to 0.9, then 1.0.

explanations.title: Pairs of tenths that make 1
explanations.text: Two decimal tenths can make 1 together. For example, 0.2 and 0.8 make 1. Each tenth has a partner.

explanations.title: Meters and centimeters work the same way
explanations.text: Cut 1 meter into 10 equal parts. Each part is 0.1 meter. Cut 1 centimeter into 10 equal parts. Each part is 0.1 centimeter.

objective.text: Show that tenths and hundredths are equivalent. Use the area model and place value disks.

explanations.title: Tenths and hundredths by division
explanations.text: 10 hundredths and 1 tenth are the same amount. Divide the top and bottom of 30 over 100 by 10 to get 3 over 10. Ten is a common factor of 10 and 100.

explanations.title: Hundredths by multiplication
explanations.text: Multiply the number of tenths by 10 to get hundredths. Divide the number of hundredths by 10 to get tenths. You only change the unit. The value stays the same.

explanations.title: Hundredths on an area model
explanations.text: Cut each tenth into 10 equal parts to make hundredths. A fast way to shade 25 hundredths is to shade 2 whole tenths, then 5 more hundredths.

explanations.title: Compose 10 hundredths into 1 tenth
explanations.text: 10 hundredths trade for 1 tenth. Circle each group of 10 hundredths disks. 16 hundredths is 1 tenth and 6 hundredths. It is like 10 ones make 1 ten.

explanations.title: Write hundredths as a decimal
explanations.text: Hundredths use two places after the decimal point. 5 hundredths is 0.05. 25 hundredths is 0.25. A 0 holds the tenths place.
